title: Book Three · Chapter 110: The Music in the Square
story:
On Sunday, Mum puts her needle away before the afternoon light fades.

“A walk?” she asks Dad.

He looks at his work shoes near the door.

“In the other pair.”

Ronan is finishing a short piece of school work. He has one line left, then closes the book and goes with them.

The small square is busy. A man is playing a violin beneath a tree. Two people sit beside him and beat time softly with their hands.

Mum stops at once.

“That tune.”

Dad looks at her. “You know it?”

“You used to know it too.”

She taps her foot and listens. Dad keeps his hands in his pockets for a moment. Then he begins to hum.

The first part is right. The next goes somewhere else.

Mum looks at him and laughs.

“That is another song.”

“Then he can play mine next.”

Ronan laughs too. They find a place beside a low wall. He sits, Mum sits, and Dad stands behind them.

Near the end of the tune, an older woman comes over with a full shopping bag. Ronan moves aside, then stands up so she can sit.

“Thank you,” she says.

He takes his place beside Dad. For a while, both listen quietly.

When the music stops, Mum claps. The woman beside her tells her about another tune she likes. Soon the two are talking as the players choose the next piece.

Ronan watches Mum's face. She is not counting stitches or talking about a sleeve now.

Dad leans toward him.

“She will know all the songs before we leave.”

“You can learn the second parts.”

Dad smiles. He tries the first few notes of the new tune very softly.

This time, Mum does not turn. Ronan keeps his face straight until Dad's voice stops.

“Better?” Dad asks.

“Quieter.”

They both laugh under the sound of the violin.

The next piece is slower. Mum sits still, with her hands together in her lap. Dad listens all the way through.

On the road home, the sky is pale above the roofs. Mum talks about the violin player. Dad asks which song he should learn first.

“One at a time,” she says.

Ronan walks between them. At the bread-shop corner, he sees two students from school and lifts a hand.

Then Mum begins to hum the tune again. Dad follows the first part correctly. Ronan joins with the notes he remembers.

They carry it as far as the green door. Inside, Dad puts his good shoes away before he asks about dinner.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

violin＝小提琴；tune＝曲调；beat time＝打拍子；lap＝坐着时的大腿上方。

## 理解问题

1. 这次外出主要是谁主动提出、谁真正喜欢听音乐？父母是否只有工作和家用两件事？
2. Ronan给老妇人怎样的实际帮助？一家人的轻松笑话来自什么？

## 读句子

**Ronan moves aside, then stands up so she can sit.**

拆开看：Ronan / moves aside, / then stands up / so she can sit.

Ronan／先让开一些／随后站起来／让那位女士可以坐下。
